status: frozen after V19R response commissioning and V19S HI4PI acquisition passed, but before grouping the commissioning PHA, loading it in Sherpa, evaluating APEC, fitting a temperature or normalization, reading a fit statistic, opening lensing data, or changing gravity physics
purpose: Commission the frozen thermal spectral fit on the deterministic V19R response cell before scheduling the 5082-cell response-and-temperature production batch.

commissioning_cell.selection_rule: the already-frozen unique maximum source-count V19Q task

model.engine: Sherpa 4.18 with XSPEC 12.14 and installed AtomDB
model.background_treatment: subtract using the V19R effective blank-sky AREASCAL

normalization.initial_rule: max(1e-8, 0.01 times the background-unsubtracted 0.5-7.0 count rate in counts per second)

model.optimization: levmar; if it fails or returns a non-finite statistic, run neldermead and then one levmar polish
model.uncertainty: Sherpa conf 68-percent profile-likelihood interval for temperature with normalization profiled

gates.failure_rule: retain and report the failed commissioning fit; do not change grouping, energy band, nH, redshift, abundance, statistic, optimizer sequence or parameter bounds

interpretation.reason: one response cell is an engineering fit commissioning target; thermodynamic science requires every admitted region combined over all supporting observations and CCDs
